data.name: Aneeqa
data.long_meaning: Derived from 'an-naqi' (free from impurities). In Arabic, an-naqi means 'pure, clean, free from defects or blemishes'. This name signifies a person who is pure in heart and soul.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of Maryam bint Imran (Mary), mother of Prophet Isa (Jesus) in Islamic tradition.

In the Islamic faith, being pure in the heart and soul is considered a fundamental aspect of leading a righteous and pious life. The name serves as a continuous reminder for its bearer to strive towards inner purity. By embodying this name, one is encouraged to cultivate moral virtues, and to resist negative traits such as anger, greed, pride and lust. Ultimately, 'Aneeqa' is a name that inspires one to be a beacon of light, spreading positivity and good deeds, and remaining free from worldly impurities.
